objective: Design dilute Cu-alloy electrocatalysts with high CO2-to-propylene partial current density, then rank unseen designs by j_propylene.

measurements.name: j_propylene
measurements.description: propylene partial current density in mA cm^-2 (geometric): the largest of j * FE_C3H6 / 100 over the screening current densities j = 100, 200, 300 mA cm^-2

deliverable.description: UTF-8 JavaScript defining a deterministic, pointwise predict(composition) that returns a finite number; larger means higher predicted j_propylene

design_space.description: dilute Cu alloys: Cu >= 0.95 with one or two of the other 14 metals, in 1 at.% steps; composition strings list elements in atomic-number order with two-decimal atomic fractions
design_space.rules: every stage orders from the same catalog; each design can be measured at most once
